column1: # Byte-identity harness: one row per OpenBSD daemon whose parse.y hbnf
#   name    parse.y path (rel. to extracted root)
#           conf struct      header (rel. to extracted root)
# The conf struct is the tree parse.y builds; byte-identity is measured
# against its layout in the real OpenBSD header.
# pfctl is the odd one out: parse.y's output is a list of kernel `struct
# pf_rule` (built via parser-internal node_* helpers), so the grammar targets
# pf_rule, not the parser's own `struct pfctl`.
